text.title: Roadmap Design Procedure
text.summary: Step-by-step procedure to apply Roadmap Design end-to-end. Each step names its input, action, and output. Folds in the former process file: Five-step process from strategy input through stakeholder communication, including theme definition and confidence levels.

step.name: gather-strategy-inputs
step.action: Gather four inputs before touching the roadmap format: company/product vision, business goals for the period, user research insights, and technical constraints. Output: clear objectives for the roadmap period.
step.note: A roadmap without strategy inputs is a backlog sorted by recency. The objectives from this step are the connective tissue between every initiative and the business direction.

step.name: assess-uncertainty
step.action: Score uncertainty low / medium / high over that horizon.

step.name: pick-format
step.action: Map uncertainty and the external-sharing requirement to a format per r6. Do not let audience preference drive it.
step.note: Use the selection matrix from content/01-formats.xml as a deterministic first step. Do not let the audience or personal preference drive the format choice — let uncertainty level and external-sharing requirement drive it. (The matrix now lives in the "Format catalogue and selection matrix" section of `content/01-core-rules.xml`.)
Format chosen by audience preference produces a timeline roadmap for high-uncertainty work because stakeholders always want dates. The matrix overrides this bias.

step.name: anchor-outcomes
step.action: Translate outcomes into horizon-eligible roadmap entries.

step.name: define-themes
step.action: Group planned work into 3–5 themes per r12, each naming the objective it drives, why now, and 2–3 example initiatives; every initiative links to one objective ID per r16.

step.name: place-horizons
step.action: Sort into the chosen format's buckets (Now / Next / Later when r2 applies) with confidence labels (distribution per r13, Now capped at 5 per r14); add the explicit not-doing list at horizon scope per r10 and the horizon context per r15.

step.name: emit-external
step.action: Derive the external view per r7 — strip metric targets, confidence labels and owners per r8. Human review before it leaves.

step.name: review-cadence-setup
step.action: Book the monthly internal review and the quarterly external publish per r9; assign owner.

step.name: publish-and-iterate
step.action: Publish to audience; capture feedback; revisit on the booked beats. Diff against the previous snapshot with `templates/roadmap-diff.py`.

text.reference: Automated validator for required keys, Now initiative count, not_doing field, and objective links
